title: Concept: Perl module load error with its search path
description: A Perl module error that lists the search path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message prints the include path and the expected module, which discloses the library layout of the host and the modules the application depends on.
applicability: Deployments that render a Perl module error that lists the search path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message prints the include path and the expected module, which discloses the library layout of the host and the modules the application depends on.
